zh.legendCard1Body: 传说，七宝之名来自一座寺。五代时吴越王钱镠曾驻跸于此，把“陆宝”听成了“六宝”，赐下金字莲花经，说这也是一宝。于是庵改名七宝寺，镇以寺名。
zh.legendCard1Note: 以上为民间流传的说法，七宝的建置沿革可参阅地方志。
zh.legendCard2Hint: 轻触上方宝物图标，查看民间传说来历
zh.legendCard2Note: 七件宝物之说源自民间口耳相传。
zh.treasure1Desc: 传为吴越王钱镠所赐金字写经，奉为镇寺之宝。
zh.treasure2Desc: 相传古寺旁有千年古梓，枝叶繁茂，庇佑一方水土。
zh.treasure3Desc: 传自水路漂流而至的古铜巨钟，钟声洪亮，声闻数里。
zh.treasure4Desc: 相传自远方飞临七宝寺的铁铸佛像，宝相庄严。
zh.treasure5Desc: 民间传说中破晓报明的灵禽，护佑镇民安居乐业。
zh.treasure6Desc: 传说中温润生辉的白玉箸，试毒辨味、不染微尘。
zh.treasure7Desc: 相传为修造古寺殿宇时显迹的神工玉斧。
zh.legendCard3Body: 传说里的七宝早已散落成谜。今天，我们在老街上重新集七宝——穿行在蒲汇塘两岸的炉灶炊烟与石桥深巷，收集属于当下的市井温度。
zh.allCollectedNotice: 七件烟火之宝已全部集齐，快生成你的专属集章卡吧！
zh.mapHint: 轻触老街上的印章，探访水乡烟火

zh.infoTransitBody: 乘坐上海轨道交通 9 号线至七宝站，出站步行约 8–10 分钟即可抵达七宝老街牌坊。
zh.infoTicketsBody: 七宝古镇街区全天免费开放；内部展馆通常于 9:00 至 17:00 开放，部分展馆收费，以景区现场公示为准。
zh.infoTipsBody: 老街南北大街巷道较窄，节假日游客较多，建议错峰出行；南大街餐饮茶点集中，临河石板路行走请注意防滑。
zh.infoCreditsBody: 穿行于七宝古镇千年历史脉络，记录蒲汇塘两岸真实的市井烟火与水乡生活温度。
zh.infoDeclarationBody: 本作品为闵行区“心动闵行·记录美好”网络作品征集活动（主题一：烟火闵行）参赛作品。手绘风矢量示意地图、印章视觉与交互代码由项目组原创制作；字体调用设备原生系统字族；互动音效与江南氛围音基于 Web Audio API 实时程序化合成，无第三方版权纠纷。

en.appSubtitle: A Day of Everyday Magic in a Thousand-Year-Old Town
en.loading: Steeping tea and unrolling the ancient riverside...
en.loadingReady: The ancient town scroll is ready. Step inside!
en.legendCard1Body: Legend says the town took its name from a temple. A king of the Wuyue kingdom once stayed here, granted a golden lotus sutra, and called it one more treasure — and the temple became the 'Temple of Seven Treasures'.
en.legendCard1Note: This is a local legend; the town's documented history can be found in local chronicles.
en.legendCard2Hint: Tap each relic icon above to read its folk legend
en.legendCard2Note: The story of the seven relics has been passed down through local folklore.
en.treasure1Desc: A royal scripture written in gold ink, gifted by King Qian Liu of Wuyue.
en.treasure2Desc: A millennial catalpa tree by the ancient temple, sheltering the town.
en.treasure3Desc: A bronze bell said to have drifted here by water, its chime echoing for miles.
en.treasure4Desc: An iron Buddha statue said to have arrived from afar according to local lore.
en.treasure5Desc: A mythical auspicious rooster heralding dawn and peace for townsfolk.
en.treasure6Desc: Pure white jade chopsticks of legend, untouched by dust.
en.treasure7Desc: A legendary jade axe associated with master craftsmanship of the temple.
en.legendCard3Body: The old treasures have become legend. Today, let's collect a new seven on the old street — wandering along Puhuitang River to gather the living warmth of everyday town life.

en.infoTransitBody: Take Shanghai Metro Line 9 to Qibao Station and walk about 8–10 minutes to the Qibao Old Street archway.
en.infoTicketsBody: The historic street area is open all day with free admission; indoor exhibition halls typically open 9:00–17:00, and some charge a fee as posted on site.
en.infoTipsBody: The historic alleys are narrow and can be crowded on holidays; off-peak visits are recommended. Watch your step on riverside cobblestones.
en.infoCreditsBody: Strolling through the thousand-year heritage of Qibao, celebrating the enduring warmth of daily life along Puhuitang River.
en.infoDeclarationBody: Created for the Minhang District 'Heartfelt Minhang · Recording Beauty' Online Content Call (Theme 1: Bustling Minhang).
